'''Arden Telowe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who operated [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Desert Survey Office/Legends|Desert Survey Office]] during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He used an outdated [[Ranger-5 swoop]].

==History==
Arden Telowe lived in the office in between expeditions into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|desert]], always in search of scrap or salvage with his [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] assistant [[Slaff]]. Additionally, a [[Unidentified furtive Jawa|furtive Jawa]] visited on a regular basis, updating information. It was suspected that they were engaged in underhanded dealings.

Despite his efforts to explore as much of the desert as he could, Telowe never updated the official map in the Desert Survey Office. He kept many locations, such as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]' hideouts and possible mining locations, to himself, often selling them to the local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelords]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Telowe found himself the object of an intense search, ostensibly led by his long-lost sister, [[Masda Telowe]]. However, Masda turned out to be his former wife, whom he had left on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] with a huge debt to repay. Masda hired a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to trail her after she hired some local [[guide]]s to help track down Telowe. The [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] managed to find Telowe in a canyon [[Cave/Legends|cave]], and he was approached by his wife and the bounty hunters to seek her revenge.

==Behind the scenes==
Arden Telowe appears in the article ''[[Secrets of Mos Eisley]]'' in [[2001]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 7]]''.
